hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that manages a Registered → Launching → Live lifecycle, restricting swaps to the factory during launch and applying a time-based anti-snipe fee (higher fee for SNIPE_DURATION seconds post-launch). Fees are extracted via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas in native ETH and routed to a per-pool FeeVault for the creator. Maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle updated on every swap.
